plan.title: Complete the vBRIEF → xBRIEF rename across code, docs, skills, and UI
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: Upstream renamed the spec vBRIEF → xBRIEF at v0.7.0 (UK trademark, deftai/xBRIEF#11). Overdeck already emits xBRIEF v0.8 documents with the xBRIEFInfo on-disk envelope, but internal naming is still almost entirely 'vBRIEF': the src/lib/vbrief/ module (14 files), the canonical vBRIEFInfo TS field (io.ts normalizes xBRIEFInfo → vBRIEFInfo internally), frontend components/vbrief/ and 'vBRIEF' UI copy, the *.vbrief.json extension baked into FILENAME_RE plus ~8 endsWith sites, docs/VBRIEF.md, the write-vbrief skill, role/prompt templates, and 359 spec + 150 continue files on overdeck-state still named *.vbrief.json (312 of the specs still carry the vBRIEFInfo envelope).
narratives.Proposal: Adopt xBRIEF completely in ordered slices: (1) pure git-mv of src/lib/vbrief → src/lib/xbrief with import updates; (2) flip the canonical envelope field to xBRIEFInfo — serializer always emits xBRIEFInfo, readers accept vBRIEFInfo indefinitely, locked by a legacy fixture test; (3) mechanical XBrief* identifier rename; (4) new files written *.xbrief.json with readers accepting both extensions (continue writer reuses an existing legacy-named file — no duplicates); (5) an idempotent admin migration command (fixture-tested; live run is an explicit post-merge/post-deploy step because pre-deploy renames would be invisible to running old code); (6) frontend dir/component/copy rename; (7) write-xbrief skill + redirect stub; (8) prompt/role/CLI string sweep; (9) docs/XBRIEF.md + Mintlify sweep + migration note; (10) final grep audit producing the per-file justification list required by the issue's AC-1.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do NOT run the state migration against any live ${OVERDECK_HOME}/state/<project>/ worktree in this branch (post-merge/post-deploy operator step only)
- Do NOT drop or break reading of legacy vBRIEFInfo envelopes or *.vbrief.json filenames — legacy read-compat is permanent
- Do NOT rewrite historical artifacts: docs/prds/**, docs/design/**, docs/research/**, .release/**, design/style-guide/mockups/**, changelog entries, closed-issue records
- Do NOT rename the workspace migration-compat path PAN_SPEC_FILENAME ('spec.vbrief.json') or the legacy root vbrief/{proposed,active,...} lifecycle dirs and their reader findLegacyVBriefByIssue
- Do NOT rename the pan CLI, the xBRIEF spec version (stays 0.8), or issue/branch/workspace naming conventions
- Do NOT introduce a third UI term ('Spec') — UI copy standardizes on 'xBRIEF'

autoDecisions.summary: Rename all VBrief* TypeScript identifiers, not only the vBRIEFInfo envelope field.
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue AC-1 requires `git grep -il vbrief` to return only justified occurrences; hundreds of live identifier hits cannot be justified as legacy-compat read paths, so a partial rename cannot pass the gate.

autoDecisions.summary: Serializer always emits the xBRIEFInfo envelope; version-based envelope selection (vBRIEFInfo for < 0.7) is removed; readers accept both keys indefinitely.
autoDecisions.rationale: Round-trip preservation existed to prevent silent up-conversion; this issue's explicit committed migration supersedes it, and an always-xBRIEFInfo serializer makes the migration idempotent with normal write-door rewrites. State docs are internal — no external consumer depends on the legacy envelope for old versions.

autoDecisions.summary: State migration takes the full option — envelope rewrite AND *.vbrief.json → *.xbrief.json renames — shipped as an idempotent admin command; the live run is deferred to post-merge/post-deploy.
autoDecisions.rationale: Committed renames are reversible via git (the issue names this), and deferring the live run avoids the deploy-order hazard where old deployed code (endsWith '.vbrief.json') cannot see renamed files for ~49 active issues.

autoDecisions.summary: UI copy uses 'xBRIEF' wherever it said 'vBRIEF', rather than the issue's alternative neutral 'Spec'.
autoDecisions.rationale: One consistent term across docs, CLI, and UI; introducing 'Spec' would create a third name for the same artifact and more copy churn.

autoDecisions.summary: write-vbrief becomes a compatibility-redirect stub pointing at the renamed write-xbrief skill.
autoDecisions.rationale: Follows the existing all-up → pan-flywheel redirect precedent in sync-sources/skills/, preserving muscle memory without keeping duplicate content.

narrative.Action: Add an xbrief migration subcommand to the admin state-migrate family (src/cli/commands/admin/state-migrate.ts or a sibling, wired like existing admin verbs). For a given project's state worktree it: (a) rewrites every specs/*.json envelope vBRIEFInfo → xBRIEFInfo (content otherwise preserved; version field untouched), (b) git-mv-renames specs/*.vbrief.json and continues/*.vbrief.json to .xbrief.json (continues are rename-only — they have no envelope), (c) commits once through the state write door with a message naming PAN-2829, (d) is idempotent (second run exits 0 reporting nothing to do), (e) supports --dry-run printing planned changes without touching the worktree. Tests run against a temp fixture state worktree. MUST NOT be executed against any live ${OVERDECK_HOME}/state/* in this branch (hazard H1) — the live run is a documented post-merge/post-deploy operator step.
